messages:
maria: Heads-up — prepping paid search + retarget push to back Thursday webinar (11am PT). Need quick plan: pacing, retarget windows, and first-pass creative. Who can own what?
ben: I can own search setup and pacing. Suggest 3-day and 14-day retarget lists. Start $1.2k/day, ramp to $2k if CTR/CPA look good.
ella: I9ll do creative variants — two headlines (webinar benefit vs benchmark narrative) + two image options for retarget carousel. CTA: 'Join live' + urgency line.
sam: Analytics will do UTM and dashboard. Recommend attribution 7d click / 1d view. Set CPA alert at $120.
maria: Exclude recent registrants? 30d?
ben: Yes exclude 30d registrants. Retarget windows: 0-3d (high), 4-14d (mid), 15-30d (low). Cap freq at 3/day. Bid higher for 0-3d.
ella: Creative A idea: stat headline '2x throughput at 1/3 cost'. Creative B: softer 'See how teams cut inference cost'. Which for search vs retarget?
ben: Use stat headline in search exact-match & branded. Retarget carousel test both.
maria: Sam drop tracking template here and dashboard link pls.
sam: Tracking template to paste in Final URL Suffix:
```
utm_source=google&utm_medium=cpc&utm_campaign=webinar_mar26&utm_term={keyword}&utm_content={ad_id}
```
Dashboard: https://analytics.redwood.example/dashboards/webinar-mar26 (share view link tomorrow).
ben: Ad scheduling: weekdays 6-10am PT and 4-10pm PT, evening bid +15%. Dayparting helps CPA.
ella: For retarget I'll make two carousels: product benefits (3 cards) and a case-study snapshot (3 cards). Assets in Figma by EOD tomorrow.
maria: Budget: $8k total. Split proposal: 60% search / 30% retarget / 10% discovery. Thoughts?
ben: Good. I'll set daily caps. Also plan a 48hr post-registration remarket with recording for no-shows.
ad-bot: Draft campaigns created: "Webinar_Mar26_Search" and "Webinar_Mar26_Retarget". Policy checks pending.
maria: Owners: ben (search/pacing), ella (creative), sam (tracking/dashboard). I'll QA and approve final ads. Launch target 9am PT Thursday (3h before webinar).
sam: Adding CPA & registration alerts to #marketing-alerts and email to owners.
ben: QA checklist: final URLs, tracking template, audiences, exclusions, budget caps. I'll run 1h before launch.
ella: Ping me for resizing needs — source files in Figma.
maria: Refresh cadence: day 3 and day 7; rotate winners into search. :eyes:
ben: Sounds good. :thumbsup:
ella: on it.
ad-bot: Campaigns scheduled for 2026-03-26 09:00:00 PT pending final publish by ben.
maria: Will post final approval screenshot here when live. Thanks!
